title: Optionals via PEP 604 unions fail to validate with typeguard 2.13.3
author: brendancooley

comments.author: patrick-kidger
comments.body:
Thanks for the report! This is basically just because `|` (i.e. `types.UnionType`) came out after `typeguard==2.13.3` did, so quite understandably it doesn't know how to handle it 😁 

As a practical matter I've fixed this by including a monkey-patch in #350, i.e. the 0.3.3 release. :)
